secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Gemini AI API key for the AI assistant. Get it from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). Required for Gemini AI chat functionality.

secrets.name: MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps API key for Maps SDK and Maps Compose. Get it from Google Cloud Console (console.cloud.google.com) under APIs & Services > Credentials. Required for Google Maps integration.

secrets.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL for operations team alerts on order status changes. Get it from Slack > Apps > Incoming Webhooks (your-workspace.slack.com/services/new/incoming-webhook). Create a webhook for the #operaciones channel.
